name: @jiscribe/cli
description: Command-line checking, measuring and diagnosing of jiscribe documents

comments.dependencies: Everything but fontkit is bundled into dist/index.mjs. The three that stay listed are resolved by path at run time rather than imported, from dist/ upwards: @jiscribe/doc-schema holds the JSON schema, and the @fontsource packages hold the font files the Node measurer reads (see @jiscribe/doc-tools). Drop one and the bundle still builds, then fails on first use.
comments.devDependencies: The canvas, the standard shape set, react and katex are the render harness's ingredients (harness/, bundled into dist/harness by buildHarness.mjs). Nothing under src/ imports them: the CLI itself stays headless.
